name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-mind
description: Knowledge about the mind, in your memory: cognitive biases, mental disorders, schools of psychology, neuroscience, memory and learning. MnemoMind reads Wikipedia by category (English, French, Spanish; CC BY-SA 4.0), the OpenStax Psychology 2e textbook (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and the health topics of the US National Institute of Mental Health (public domain), and keeps them in your knowledge folder and in one memory pack per topic. Every memory ends with its source, its date and its licence. It gives no medical advice.

descriptionI18n.es: El conocimiento sobre la mente, en tu memoria: sesgos cognitivos, trastornos mentales, corrientes de la psicología, neurociencia, memoria y aprendizaje. MnemoMind lee Wikipedia por categoría (inglés, francés, español; CC BY-SA 4.0), el manual OpenStax Psychology 2e (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) y los temas de salud del Instituto Nacional de Salud Mental de Estados Unidos (dominio público), y los guarda en tu carpeta de conocimientos y en un paquete de memoria por tema. agentGuide: Name a text the way the person says it (« effet de halo », « Halo effect »): add finds it by its title in the list. Several matches are refused with their titles (AMBIGUOUS): pick one and call again.
Without topic or source, entries, add and addAll work on the topic and the list open on screen; listSource takes the topic on screen.
To look: openTopic for a topic, listSource for a source list, goHome for the five topics. setLanguage changes Wikipedia’s language.
MnemoMind files texts; it does not read, sum up or comment on them, and gives no medical advice.

agentActions.summary: Say what MnemoMind shows and holds: the topic on screen, the job running, and what is already in memory per topic and source
agentActions.details: inMemory has one line per topic, source and language: entries in memory, failed, refused by the source, listed the last time the list was read. library is reading or unreadable while the record of what is in memory is not read; nothing can be added then.

agentActions.summary: List the five topics and the sources each one offers, with their languages
agentActions.details: Topics: biases, disorders, schools, neuro, memory. Sources: wikipedia (en, fr, es), openstax (Psychology 2e, en), nimh (disorders only, en).

agentActions.summary: Show one topic's screen, as a click on its tile does
Go back to the five topics, as the Back link does
agentActions.details: Refused during an import; a list being read stops.

agentActions.summary: Choose the language Wikipedia is read in, as the language box does
Read again the record of what is in memory when it was unreadable, as the Retry button does
Open a source's list of texts in a topic, as its Open button does, and say how many there are
agentActions.details: The topic is shown and the list read on screen. Answers the count and the first 30 entries; page through them with entries. A list that takes longer than 45 s answers running: call status, then entries.

agentActions.details: Starts and answers at once: the import runs on screen while MnemoMind stays open and resumes where it stopped. Call status for progress, stop to stop.
